title.en: Income Tax (Armada 98/2 Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(4) Exemption) Notification 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Income Tax (Armada 98/2 Pte. Ltd. — Section 13(4) Exemption) Notification 2026 and is deemed to have come into operation on 29 September 2023.

2.—(1) The interest payable by Armada 98/2 Pte. Ltd. under a syndicated term loan facility agreement dated 13 April 2023 for the purposes of financing the construction of the Floating, Production, Storage and Offloading vessel named “Armada Sterling V” —
(a)to the respective lenders mentioned in the first column of the following table;
(b)in respect of the respective loan amounts mentioned in the second column of the table; and
(c)that is due and payable during the respective periods mentioned in the third column of the table,
is exempt from tax:
